Subject: [PATCH] ASoC: fsl: imx-es8328: Remove leftover gpio initialisation

The gpio field is not used anymore, remove the leftover.
This also fixes the compilation error after the ...

Fixes: 9855f05e5536 ("ASoC: fsl: imx-es8328: Switch to using gpiod API")
Signed-off-by: Andy Shevchenko <andriy.shevchenko@linux.intel.com>
Link: https://msgid.link/r/20240325191341.3977321-1-andriy.shevchenko@linux.intel.com
Signed-off-by: Mark Brown <broonie@kernel.org>

diff --git a/sound/soc/fsl/imx-es8328.c b/sound/soc/fsl/imx-es8328.c
index d67b8a149bff..5b9648f3b087 100644
--- a/sound/soc/fsl/imx-es8328.c
+++ b/sound/soc/fsl/imx-es8328.c
@@ -28,7 +28,6 @@ struct imx_es8328_data {
 
 static struct snd_soc_jack_gpio headset_jack_gpios[] = {
 	{
-		.gpio = -1,
 		.name = "headset-gpio",
 		.report = SND_JACK_HEADSET,
 		.invert = 0,
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `sound/soc/fsl/imx-es8328.c`**
   - The line initializing the `gpio` field in the `headset_jack_gpios` structure has been removed. Specifically, the line `gpio = -1` was deleted, indicating that the `gpio` field is no longer used.

### Relationships
- The modification in `imx-es8328.c` addresses a leftover code issue related to the `gpio` field, which is no longer necessary following a previous change that switched to using the gpiod API. This change resolves a compilation error that arose due to the unused `gpio` field, thereby improving code cleanliness and functionality. The patch is linked to a prior commit (identified by the hash `9855f05e5536`) that introduced the gpiod API usage, indicating a direct relationship between the two changes.
